Not a big political commentator, and missed this earlier, but glad to see logic prevail for once. 

Easily one of the most unfair laws enacted in recent history. Unrealized income is an untouchable subject and for good reason. setting that precedent would completely nuke any economy. 

Always highly skeptical of anything “bipartisan”, but we finally got one right.
